<meta>This page continues the technical instructions of Sahl ibn Bishr (often called Zabel), a 9th-century Jewish astrologer and mathematician. While the previous page focused on the stability of kings, this page transitions into "interrogations"—a branch of astrology where a chart is drawn for the specific moment a person asks a question. The text moves from general hopes to specific questions about animal racing (the 12th house) and the contents of letters.</meta>

# On Interrogations

...joy, love, and gladness. If, however, it is from a fourth aspect <note>original: "ex 4° aspectu"; this refers to a square aspect (90 degrees), usually considered a sign of tension</note> or an opposition: there will be contention and striving in the conjunction of those planets; each of them will be contrary to his companion, and in the opposition the contention will be even stronger.

## ¶ A question concerning a hope not expressed, whether one may attain it according to its kind.

And if you are asked about a matter that has not been explained to you, and the person says to you: "Look at the thing I hope for, and in which I have trust; see whether I shall have it or not." Look at the Lord of the Ascendant <note>the planet that rules the sign rising on the eastern horizon</note> and the Moon; if they are joined to the "fortunes" <note>the favorable planets, Jupiter and Venus</note> from the angles <note>the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</note>, or from the houses following the angles, he shall attain it. If, however, they are not joined, say "no." And if he has not named the thing, seek it from its own place in the circle <note>the zodiac</note> according to what I have explained to you regarding the substances of the 12 significators <note>the twelve houses of the horoscope, each governing different life areas like money, siblings, or health</note>.

## ¶ The twelfth sign or the 12th house with its questions, and first, which beast shall win the prize in a race.

<image-desc>A large ornamental initial 'A' set within a square frame with floral decorations.</image-desc>
When you are asked about beasts—such as which beast shall win in a race—and a question is asked about a beast competing for a prize, or if someone is suspicious of a certain beast: look at the Lord of the Hour <note>the planet ruling the specific hour of the day the question is asked</note> in which you are asked. If that planet is in the Ascendant, the beast that was suspected <note>the one the person is asking about</note> shall win over all the other beasts. And if it is in the Midheaven <note>the 10th house, representing success</note>, it will come second—that is, it will come after the first; and similarly if it is in the 11th house. And if it is in the 7th house from the Ascendant, it will be in the middle of them. And if it is in the 4th house, it will be the very last, and no beast will be behind it. And if the Lord of the Hour is in its "fall" <note>original: "defcensiōe"; a sign where a planet's influence is weakened</note>, that same running beast will be terrified by that movement and fall. And if, in addition to what I have said, the "malefics" <note>unfavorable planets, Mars and Saturn</note> behold it, the part of its body signified by that sign shall be broken. If, however, a malefic looks at it from an opposition, or is with it in the same sign, and it is the Lord of the Ascendant of its 8th house <note>the house of death</note>, the one that runs shall die from that fall, and even more surely if the Lord of that house or the Moon is hindered.

## ¶ A question on what the color of the winning beast might be.

If someone asks who does not have a beast among the others—namely, saying "Which of those will win?"—look at the Lord of the Hour. If it is in the Ascendant, or if you find another planet in the Ascendant, or in the Midheaven, or in the 11th house, the one who wins on that day is the beast according to the colors of that planet <note>each planet was associated with specific colors: e.g., Saturn with black, Mars with red</note> which is in any of those places. And if the significator of the winner is in its own house, or its exaltation, or its triplicity, or its term or face <note>these are the various "essential dignities" or strengths a planet has based on its position</note>, that beast which wins will be graceful and well-known—and all the more worthy if it is in its house or exaltation; and whatever comes from this <unclear>malū</unclear> <note>original text says "malū" (evil), but context suggests it should be "good" or "strength"</note> will be. If, however, it is not in any of these dignities we have mentioned, it will be unknown; and if, in addition to what I have told you, it is in its fall, it has a malicious habit and a very bad spirit. In its exaltation and house, it will be graceful; in its triplicity, it will not be known in its own land and will not be graceful; in its term or face, it will be known in the land, but not graceful, for it is not known from which land it comes.

## ¶ A question concerning the age of the winning beast.

And if you are asked about its age, look at the significator. If it is "oriental" <note>rising before the Sun</note>, it will be of two years <note>original: "ventiū"; likely a scribal error for "annorum" (years) or referring to specific age markers</note>; and if it is "occidental" <note>setting after the Sun</note>, it will be fully grown. If it is between the two, it will be in its fourth year <note>original: "f̄m' 4°. 4̄tuoz ventiū"</note>. And if you find none of these things I have told you, look at the Ascendant. If it is the house of the Sun, the winner will be from the King's beasts. And if it is the house of Saturn, it will be a beast of great age and perhaps not well-bred, unless Saturn is in an angle or in an excellent place. And if it is in the house of Jupiter, it will be a winning beast belonging to some honored person who assists the King. And if it is the house of Mars, the winning animal will belong to some leader who wears armor and is a warrior. And if it is the house of Venus or Mercury, it will belong to some noble, or a king, or a woman, or a scribe. If, however, it is the house of the Moon, it will belong to some merchant, and that beast is shown specifically so that it may be sold.

## ¶ A question concerning all enemies, what shall be between them.

And if you are asked about all enemies from the 12th house and its Lord; or if one man is named to you, look to the 7th house and its Lord. Look at what shall be between them in their conjunctions, just as I have explained to you. For I have already explained matters to you in the questions of the 12 signs; and now I shall explain things that are not in the 12 signs, lest perhaps you err; for wise men have already erred in this, because they were not in the 12 signs. Receive this from the substances of the planets, for things are more numerous than can be comprehended.

## ¶ A question concerning a letter or a messenger.

<column-break/>

<image-desc>A large ornamental initial 'C' set within a square frame with floral decorations.</image-desc>
When you are asked about a letter or a messenger, look at the writing of the letter from the Ascendant, and from that planet from which the Moon separates, and from the 7th house and its Lord for the one to whom it is written: whatever is hoped for or feared, or whatever is in the mind of both men. And their state is from the Lord of the Ascendant, and the Lord of the 7th, and from their places according to the aspect of the "fortunes" and "malefics" toward them. Whichever of them is in the angles, or in a place in which it is "received" <note>a planet in a sign ruled by another planet that it can "see"</note>, and looks toward its own place, will be greater and more worthy than the other. And if the planet from which the Moon is separated is a "fortune," or is in its exaltation, the letter will be from a lord of the kingdom. If, however, it is far from the angles, he formerly had a kingdom, but now he is removed from it. If, however, it is in its own house and in an angle, it will be from well-known members of the household. It is also from the more worthy members of his house, and he holds some dignity. And the "triplicity" is within the house; similarly, the "term" is within the triplicity, and the "face" is within the term. If it is in a good place from the Ascendant but is not received, he shall have dignity but will not be praiseworthy; he is ungrateful among the men of his house. If, however, it is in its fall and is in an angle, the one who wrote the letter will not be graceful, but he will be with the King, and one who is honored. And if it is in its fall and is "cadent" <note>in a weak house: the 3rd, 6th, 9th, or 12th</note>, he will not be graceful, nor will he be known among men. If it does not look toward the Ascendant, nor the Lord of the house, nor the Lord of the letter, he is capable of nothing—that is, he has nothing except what he eats daily. And if a "fortune" looks toward him, then he will be of those who work with their hands, and thus they eat. If, however, the Moon is separated from "malefics," and it is as I told you, he will be hard of heart because of what he suffers from evil. And if the Moon is separated from a square aspect or opposition or conjunction, it signifies the strength of the Lord of the letter; and it will be stronger when the Moon is in an angle in its own sign, for it signifies how much the one who wrote the letter is benevolent in his matter, and how much he is concerned by what is in the letter. After this, look at the one to whom the letter comes, from the planet to which the Moon is joined, and announce his state according to what I told you regarding the planet from which the Moon was separated. And know that when the Moon is separated from Saturn and Mercury is hindered, there will be labor in the letter and a difficult matter. And if it is separated from Jupiter, the letter will be from a noble man. And if from Mars, it will be a warrior who uses blood and who uses iron. And if from the Sun, it will be from a king. And if from Venus, it will be from a woman. If, however, it is from Saturn, there will be some vice in it. If it is from Mercury, the letter will be from a scribe or a merchant.

## ¶ How to know the state of the man to whom the letter comes.

And if you are asked about the state of the man to whom the letter comes: look at the Moon in this and its conjunction; if it is joined to Saturn, the letter was sent to an old man; if, however, it is Jupiter, to a noble; and if it is Venus, to a woman; similarly for the rest of the planets according to their substances.

## ¶ A question whether good or evil is in the letter.

And if you are asked about the letter, whether good or evil is in it: look at the "separation" of Mercury, because in this will be the letter; for all writing belongs to Mercury. Rumors also belong more strongly to Mercury—that is, to the strongest of them—and the third <note>perhaps referring to the 3rd house of communication</note> has a modest participation in this. If, therefore, Mercury is separated from "fortunes," there will be good in the letter. And if it is separated from "malefics," there will be evil in it. After this, look at the planet from which Mercury is separated and Mercury itself as the stronger—namely, the strongest of them—and establish this as the significator. If it is in the Ascendant, there will be safety, profit, and reward in it. And if it is in the second house from the Ascendant, the letter will be concerning profit <note>original: "lubam"; likely a transcription error for "lucrum" (profit)</note> in a donation—namely, in giving and receiving—and similar things pertaining to substance. And if they are in the third house, it will be from a brother or friend. It tells in the letter of a journey for which he is anxious, or it asks about his state. And if it is in the fourth house from the Ascendant, there will be some mention in the letter of that land; or perhaps it will be a letter from some relative who is older than him in age or in some ancient matter. And if it is in the 5th, it will be a letter in which some things are hoped for, and it will be from a son or a friend. If, however, it is in the sixth, it will be a letter about a servant. If, however, a "malefic" looks at that same place, it will be a letter about a sick person or the cause of a sick person. And if it is in the 7th, it will be a letter about a woman, or the state of a woman. And if it is in the 8th, it will be a letter about a dead man, or about the remains of the dead. And if it is in the 9th, there will be in the letter some admonition, or preaching and a commemoration of God, and a mention of a pilgrimage, or...

Having just discussed the 12th house (animals and hidden things), the text now transitions into specific "interrogations"—divinatory questions asked of an astrologer—regarding letters, rumors, personal fears, and legal vengeance.</meta>

...of the removal of the king. And if it [the planet] is in the 10th house, there will be a letter concerning the king: and in it is mention of the nobles and the leaders. And if it is in the 11th, it will be a letter from a friend and it contains that which pleases him: and it makes him return. And if it is in the 12th, it will be a letter in contention: or from an enemy.

### A question of what might be in a reply letter, if you desire to know.

**And if** a letter has been written: and you wish to know what its response might be. Look at the 3rd house from the 2nd conjunction: because the 1st conjunction is the indicator of what preceded regarding the letter: and the 2nd conjunction is the indicator of the response of the same letter.

### A question of whether a letter is finished or not.

**And if** you are asked about a letter: whether it is finished <note>original: "perfecta"; meaning completed or fully written</note>: or not. Look at the Moon; if she is joined to Mercury <note>the planet of communication and writing</note> it will be finished: and if he is already joined to her and has passed through the quantity of two or three degrees: say it is finished: otherwise not.

### A question of whether a letter is sealed or not.

**And if** you are asked about a letter whether it is sealed or not. Look at the Moon; if she is joined to Mercury say he will seal it. And if she has separated from him and passed him by the quantity of about two degrees: and has not passed him through the term <note>term: a specific subdivision of a zodiac sign ruled by a particular planet</note>: say that it is already sealed. And if you find Mercury with the Sun and they both aspect the ascendant <note>the eastern horizon of the chart</note>: say he will seal it. Otherwise not.

### A question of whether a letter will go out from the king or not.

**And if** you are asked about a letter whether it will go out from a prince or from a king. Look at Mercury; if he is separated from the Sun or from the Midheaven <note>original: "medio celi"; the 10th house, representing authority and kings</note> by a small separation: say it will go out: otherwise not.

### A question of whether a letter reaches the king or not.

**And if** you are asked about a letter whether it reaches the king or not. Look at Mercury; if he is joined to the lord of the Midheaven or to the Sun. say it will reach him: otherwise not.

### A question of rumors: whether they are true or false.

**When** you are asked about rumors whether they are true or false. Look at the Lord of the Ascendant or the Moon. Specifically, whichever of them is in an angle <note>the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses, where planets are most powerful</note> and begin from him. And if he is in an angle free from the "malics" <note>unfavorable planets, usually Saturn and Mars</note>: and is not joined to a cadent planet <note>cadent: planets in the 3rd, 6th, 9th, or 12th houses, considered weak or falling away</note>: the rumors will be true. If, however, he is in an angle: and is joined to a cadent planet that does not "receive" <note>reception: a technical relationship where a planet occupies a sign ruled by the planet it is approaching</note> him: there was an intention concerning them, but they will not continue nor be completed. And if the Lord of the Ascendant is not in an angle and is joined to a planet in an angle, the rumors will be true: and they will appear if it is a "fortune" <note>a favorable planet, Jupiter or Venus</note>. If, however, it is a malic and does not receive the Lord of the Ascendant: the rumors will be false. And if the Lord of the Ascendant is joined to a cadent planet: the rumors will be false unless that planet receives the Lord of the Ascendant. If, however, the Lord of the Ascendant is joined to a malic who does not receive him, it signifies the destruction of the rumors: and this will be on the part of the lord of the interrogation. And if a malic is joined to the Lord of the Ascendant: the destruction of the rumors will come from another: and he will destroy the rumors. After this, look at the Moon and her testimony with the Lord of the Ascendant; if the Lord of the Ascendant has more testimony: use his testimony. If, however, the Moon is stronger: use her testimony with the Lord of the Ascendant: if the Lord of the Ascendant is in a movable sign <note>original: "signo mobili"; Aries, Cancer, Libra, or Capricorn, which suggest change</note> or the Ascendant itself is movable: and certain malics aspect it: the rumors will be lying. Similarly if the Moon is void of course <note>original: "cursu vacua"; making no further connections with planets before leaving her sign</note>. Similarly also if the Moon is joined to a retrograde planet: even if the Lord receives her. Similarly if the Moon is joined to a cadent planet: and more craftily so if it is a malic: because it signifies a lie even if it is received. If, however, she is hindered in an angle and the malic himself does not receive her: the rumors will be false. And if she is joined to a planet in an angle: which receives her, it signifies the truth of the rumors: therefore do not seek any other testimony with it: if, however, she is joined to a "fortune" in an angle and it is even better if it is in the Midheaven: or in the Ascendant: it signifies that the rumors are true. Wherefore if she is then safely received from the malics and from retrogradation, the rumors will be completed and will improve: if, however, she is hindered by a planet that does not receive her: or by a retrograde planet: it signifies the destruction of the rumors after they were directed. Similarly if the Moon is joined to a planet in an angle or outside of it which does not receive her and the Moon is hindered: or is joined to a retrograde planet: it signifies destruction after direction. And if the Moon is hindered in an angle—

<column-break/>

—it signifies the destruction of the rumors. And if she is joined to a cadent planet: it signifies a lie if she is not received. And when she "knocks" at her disposition <note>gloss: a technical term for a planet transferring its influence</note> of a planet in an angle: the rumors will be true. If, however, the planet is in the Midheaven, there will be rumors which men already know and have appeared. And if it is in the Ascendant, it has already begun to appear: and if it is in the 7th [house], it already was and appeared and is appearing: if, however, it is in the 4th, it will be a secret.

### A question concerning a thing that is feared.

**And if** a man asks about a matter which he fears: look at the Lord of the Ascendant; if he is in any angle: and is free from malics, the rumors themselves will be lies and nothing of that which he fears shall come to him. And if the Lord of the Ascendant is in bad places: that is, in the 2nd, 7th, 6th, 8th, and 12th: fear concerning the same thing which he fears has already entered into him. If, however, the Lord of the Ascendant is in bad places and the malics have testified: he shall fall into that which he fears: if, however, they have not testified, it will be removed and will not be increased: beyond that which is in him regarding fear. And if they are in an angle and the malics aspect him from the angles, his state will be worse. Wherefore if the malic itself is the Lord of the 8th [house] from the Ascendant <note>the 8th house governs death</note>, it signifies his death and destruction. And if it is otherwise, distresses will find him. And if the malic itself is the Lord of the 12th [house] <note>the 12th house governs prisons and hidden enemies</note>, he will fear punishments and chains. If it is the Lord of the 2nd, it will take his wealth <note>original: "suba" for "substantia"; substance or property</note>: if, however, the Lord of the Ascendant is in the 12th: and the Lord of the 7th or the 12th does not aspect him: he will flee and be liberated and they will not have power over him. Similarly if with this the Moon is joined to a malic, it will demonstrate him to you, unless it is the malic who is the lord of its own house: for it signifies then that labor and distress will occur to him in his flight. If, however, it is not the lord of its house: it will show him.

### A question of whether a slain man is avenged or not: and whether one who has suffered injury will be avenged or not by restoring the injuries which he received.

**When** you are asked about a slain person whether he be avenged: or about him who suffered injuries whether he can prevail over him who did him the injuries: or if he may restore the injuries which were done to him. Look at the Ascendant: and the angle of the end of the matter: which is the 4th from the Ascendant: if they are movable signs: and the Moon is in a movable sign, he will be able to do nothing. If, however, the Lord of the Ascendant aspects the Ascendant and the Lord of the house of the Moon aspects the Moon: he shall obtain his matter quickly. If, however, it is as I have said: and the Lord of the 4th aspects the 7th, he shall obtain his matter and shed the blood of the killer: unless the Moon is joined to the "fortunes," and if after this the fortune itself is not joined to a malic: because then he will kill after a peace. And if a fortune is joined to the malics, he will kill: unless it is a conjunction from a trine <note>120 degree aspect, considered very harmonious</note> or from a sextile <note>60 degree aspect, considered harmonious</note> aspect: then it signifies that he will sustain punishments and they will bind him with iron. Wherefore if a malic is in a fixed sign <note>signo fixo: Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, or Aquarius, suggesting permanence</note>: he will die in prison. If, however, it is in a movable sign: and the Lord of that sign is faster in its course and aspects him, he will dismiss him quickly. And if it is he to whom the Moon is joined in a movable sign and he aspects the Lord of his own house with an aspect of friendship: he will escape freely. And if the aspect is from an opposition or from a fourth aspect <note>a square</note>: he will escape through battle: or through the likeness of a battle. If, however, the conjunction is in one sign, he will be dismissed quickly or will flee and depart. And if you find a "fortune" in the Ascendant: the anger itself will be extinguished on the part of his loved ones. And if the Moon with this is joined to a malic while the fortune is in its own place, the same vengeance will not be from the loved ones: for the king will avenge it from him. And if a malic is in the Ascendant: and the Moon is "fortunated": the loved ones—that is, of the slain man—will constrain him: and the king will help him: and will study to lead him out. Oh, if the Lord of the Ascendant aspects the Ascendant, his loved ones will obtain him after labor in the anger of the king. If, however, the Lord of the Ascendant does not aspect the Ascendant and the Lord of the house of the Moon aspects the Moon: the king will lead him out without the will of his loved ones. And know that every punishment which Mars signifies will be in iron and the scourge: and Saturn signifies punishment by wood: and by the prolongation of prison and narrowness.

### A question concerning any matter, whether it be true or false.

**And if** you are asked about any matter: whether it be true or false. Look at the Lord of the Ascendant and the Moon; if they are free from malics, the matter will be true in effect and profitable. If, however, they are hindered, the matter will be false. And if it is gold, take the Sun as your witness: and for silver, the Moon.

-># On Interrogations<-

### ¶ When one of two or three things is more worthy and which will be acquired.

**And if** you are asked about two or three things, which of them is more worthy: and which of them is true or false: or regarding two rumors, which of them is true or false: whether about one thing or about two things; which of them shall be obtained: or about two or three battles <note>original: "beltys," likely a transcription of "bellis"</note>, which of them shall win: or about two men, which of them shall obtain his goal. Look at the Lord of the Ascendant <note>The planet ruling the zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of the question</note>; if it is in the angles <term>Angles: the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses, the strongest positions in a chart</term>, free from evils <note>i.e., not afflicted by Mars or Saturn</note> and received by the first thing named, that thing is more worthy and shall be acquired. And if it is in the angles but impeded: it shall be that which was first named, but afterwards it shall be destroyed. And if the Lord of the Ascendant looks upon the Ascendant and is in the "succeding" houses of the angles <term>Succedent: the 2nd, 5th, 8th, and 11th houses</term>, free from evils and received: the second named thing is acquired and is more worthy. But if it is impeded: it will seem suitable, but afterwards it will be destroyed. And if the Lord of the Ascendant is "falling" <term>Cadent: the 3rd, 6th, 9th, and 12th houses, the weakest positions</term>, yet free from evils and received: the third of the named things will be more worthy and acquired. If it is impeded, it will be none of these things I have said, and the interrogation is destroyed. And judge the Moon in a similar way.

### ¶ A question if you are asked about many things.

**And if** you are asked about many things: you shall establish the Moon as the significator of the interrogation: and the stars (that is, the other planets) shall be the specific matters. Consider the proportion of the Moon according to the number of those things: because the first conjunction <note>The first time the Moon aligns with another planet</note> shall be the significator of the first question: and the second conjunction shall be the significator of the second question. And so on through the things according to the number that he named to you. Therefore, look at the strength of each individual planet in the angles or in the succedent houses: and their safety from retrograde motion and from evil influences: then combine both planets in their strength, and speak according to that amount.

### ¶ A question about the pursuit of hunting and what the catch will be.

**And if** you are asked about the pursuit of hunting and what the catch will be. Look at the Ascendant and the Lord of the Hour <note>The planet ruling the specific planetary hour of the day</note>: because that is strong in hunting: and know the nature of the Ascendant. See whether it is from the signs of quadrupeds <note>Four-footed animal signs like Aries, Taurus, Leo, Sagittarius, or Capricorn</note>: and after this, also look at the nature of the 7th sign and the Ascendant while you proceed to the hunt: or if you are asked about it, whatever sign it may be: and where the place of its Lord is and its relationship to the Lord of the Ascendant in their conjunction. And then if it is by "friendly" aspect, it signifies the easy capture of what was sought in the hunt. And if they are joined by a square aspect <note>90 degrees</note> or opposition <note>180 degrees</note>: he shall obtain the catch with labor and fatigue. If indeed they are not joined: he shall have nothing, nor shall he obtain what he desired. However, if the 7th sign is among the quadrupeds: and its Lord or the Lord of the Hour is fortunate in it or in any of the angles, he shall obtain the catch: and at the hour of the hunt <note>original: "hoza ionis," likely "hora venationis"</note> or in any of the angles he shall catch roebucks <note>original: "capzeolos"</note>. But if the Lord of the 7th is evil and the fortunes <note>Jupiter or Venus</note> fall away from it: he shall torment himself in the pursuit and catch little: and he shall fear injury <note>original: "vitiū"</note> or some impediment to his body: if Saturn is the Lord of the 7th. If indeed Mars is the Lord of the 7th and there is strength in him: he shall have the catch, but some of those who are with him in the labor shall cause him loss: and he shall be set free: because Mars holds the nature of hunting. But if Jupiter looks upon Mars, and is the Lord of the Hour or Lord of the Ascendant: he shall be saved from all that he fears and shall hunt easily: and he shall have his prize without labor and fatigue. If the 7th sign is of the air signs or the earth signs: and a fortune is in it, yet its Lord is evil: or if the Lord of the Hour is evil: he shall be safe in his hunting but shall not reach all that he desired: and the prey shall be terrified and flee from him: and his effort shall be heavy and he shall torment himself in it: unless Jupiter or Mercury is with the malefic planet that is the Lord of the Hour: for these break the malice of the evil planet and do not prohibit the hunt: because Mercury has the greatest participation in hunting along with Mars.

### ¶ A question whether hunters take much or little.

**Likewise** if you are asked about the scarcity of the hunt: or the multitude of it. Look at the Midheaven <term>Medium Coeli: the highest point in the chart, the 10th house</term> when one enters the hunt: if Mars is the Lord of the Midheaven or you find him there: and if he is in aspect to Mercury or Jupiter: or in aspect to one of them: and one of them is the Lord of the Hour: or Lord of the Ascendant, he shall have a very great catch and it shall meet him: and he shall be able to hunt with his own hands: and he shall have no labor unless Saturn is looking at Mars from an angle: or if Saturn is in the Midheaven: or is its Lord: for he sends upon the Lord of the hunt a great sadness in that which he hoped for. But if Jupiter falls away from him, and Saturn is as I have said, and Mars is in an angle, the Lord of the hunt shall find an impediment in

<column-break/>

his own body and a delay in his journey: and with this, he shall not acquire the catch: because Saturn destroys the hunt and brings delay to its Lord, especially if the hunt is on land. But in hunting on the sea, look at the Lord of the Ascendant and the Moon and the Lord of the 7th sign. If the Ascendant is an aquatic sign: or the Moon is joined to Mars: or the Lord of the Hour is joined to Mars: and Venus falls away from the aspect of the Moon: abandon this hunt with all your power: because the impediment of the Moon by Mars in water-hunting is a worse thing and of less profit: because it has no strength nor utility except with hindrance. If indeed the Moon is joined to Saturn: and Venus looks upon the Moon: the catch shall be multiplied and Saturn does not hinder the Moon in water-hunting: unless Mars is looking at the Moon: and with this, Venus is also weakened: because Mars is the enemy of Venus: when Saturn looks upon her: then one shall fear for his lordship a shipwreck: and other similar evils—namely, the malice of the water's moisture.

### ¶ A question concerning a banquet and what the guests ate.

**When** you are invited to a banquet <note>original: "provinio," likely "convivio"</note> or to any meal: or if you are asked about the food of some people, how much they ate. Look at the Ascendant; if it is a mobile sign <note>Cardinal signs: Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn</note> they ate many courses <note>original: "pulmenta," meaning relishes or dishes eaten with bread</note>. And if it is a fixed sign they ate one course. If indeed it is a common sign <note>Mutable signs: Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces</note> they ate two. And if the Moon is in the Ascendant, their food will be false <note>perhaps artificial or deceptive in quality</note>. And if Mars is in the Ascendant, there will be some bitterness in it: and Jupiter signifies sweetness. The Sun, however, signifies sharpness <note>pungency</note>: and Venus signifies "windiness" <note>likely meaning light or airy</note>—that is, the flavor of celery or rocket or mustard and other such things—and oiliness, namely the flavor of tallow or fat meat. And Mercury signifies a sharp flavor, and everything mixed. Saturn indeed signifies a harsh and insipid flavor. After this, look at the separation of the Moon and her conjunction; if she has separated from an evil planet and is joined to a fortune by a square aspect or opposition: it cannot be but that the Lord of that food showed it to him for the sake of a banquet: as happens in weddings or circumcisions: or in other such things that involve and happen to men. And if it is from a trine aspect <note>120 degrees</note> or a sextile <note>60 degrees</note>, it will be for the sake of conversation or reward, etc. But if it is a planet to which the Moon is joined in an angle: the banquet will be for one day. And if it is a common sign, it will be for many a day <note>original: "prolsyna," likely "prolixa," meaning extended</note>. And if the Lord of the house of the Moon looks upon her: their banquet will be disturbed: as there will be someone in the banquet who disturbs them: then they shall be pacified afterwards and return to the feast. And if the Moon is joined to Jupiter: it signifies the nobility of the banquet and a multitude of courses: and if she is joined to the Sun it signifies cleanliness: or the beauty of the courses or a multitude of sharp things. And if she is joined to Venus it signifies the beauty of the foods: and a multitude of sweet things with games and listening <note>music</note>: and laughter: and the sweetness of scent. And if she is joined to Mercury it signifies the presence of men in the same place: and that there is someone there who speaks wisdom and narrates it, and the courses shall be multiplied there: and the telling of histories or fables: and they shall use the meat of birds for food. And if the conjunction is with Saturn it shall signify the uncleanness of their foods and that the courses of fish and whatever comes out of the water are multiplied there. If indeed the conjunction is with Mars, it shall signify that a quarrel shall fall between them: and that they shall eat all things hot. And if he is in the Midheaven: it shall signify that a quarrel falls between them: and any planet in the Midheaven signifies that there will be a quarrel between them. Therefore, when you are invited to a banquet: and the Moon is with Mars in one sign: or joined to him from any angle: do not go to that banquet: because you will repent it in the end. Likewise when she is with Saturn: because it signifies uncleanness of foods and their [lack of] utility. And if you go: you will not find in those foods what you seek—go rather: because you will see what pleases you <note>this seems to be a contradictory or conditional statement based on the specific planet</note>. And if it is Jupiter, likewise, from which the best courses and grains are made. ¶ After this look at the Lord of the Hour: if he is in the Ascendant or in the Midheaven he will bring the food according to their profession. And if he is far from these two places they shall eat before it is brought: and it shall not be brought until this star is removed from the Ascendant or from the Midheaven. And if he is in the 7th or 4th [house], he shall not bring food until the place is filled: and as often as the Moon is joined to Mars their food will be hot. And if you are asked or invited: and the Moon is in an aquatic sign: looking at Saturn from a trine or sextile aspect, they shall eat trout. If indeed the Moon is in Libra they shall eat grains or legumes. And if she is in Gemini or Aquarius they shall eat the meat of birds. And if Saturn looks at the Moon...

header: Zahel

and in the 4th aspect <note>original: "4° aspectu," referring to a square aspect of 90 degrees, considered tense</note> or in opposition: he shall eat cold meat. And if the Sun should be joined to Mars: the whole shall be "combust" <term>Combust: a planet so close to the Sun that its power is weakened or "burned up"</term>. And if the Moon should be in Libra: or in the 4th aspect to it, do not eat cooked or raw vegetables; and in Virgo or Libra do not go near grains. And if it should be in Scorpio with the Tail <note>The "Tail of the Dragon" or South Node, often considered a point of loss or decrease</note>: beware of fat. And if it should be in Leo: beware of eating meat. And if in Sagittarius do not go near the meat of wild beasts, such as hares or foxes; and in Pisces do not eat trout, whether salted or fresh. Beware, therefore, of what I have told you regarding the locations of the Moon with the "evils" <note>the malefic planets Mars and Saturn</note> in these signs I have named to you, for they hinder those things with a heavy impediment.

And know that the Ascendant <note>the sign rising on the eastern horizon</note> signifies the cause of a feast. If it is the house of Venus, it will be the cause of a wedding. And if it be in the house of Mercury, it will be for the sake of a son or regarding children. If, however, it be in the house of Jupiter, a friend prepares that meal for him. And the 2nd house from the Ascendant signifies the vessel in which they carry the household furniture. If the 2nd sign is a "common" sign <term>Common sign: Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, or Pisces; signs that represent duality or change</term>: their vessel will be colored. And if Mars is in that same sign: there will be brass in that same vessel. And if it be Venus: there will be silver in it. And Jupiter: silver and gold; the Moon: glass; Saturn, however: wood and earthenware. And if a "fortune" <note>a benefic planet like Jupiter or Venus</note> is in the 2nd sign, it signifies the beauty of the house’s ornaments. But if the fortune is "peregrine" <term>Peregrine: a planet in a sign where it has no essential dignity, like a traveler in a strange land</term>: it will be someone else's. And if it has testimony in it: they will belong to the house.

The 3rd house signifies those who are present at the feast. The 4th from the Ascendant signifies the place where they feast. And if it is a common sign, their feast will be on a porch. And if the Sun or Jupiter be in it: their feast will be in the cloister of the house or in the south. And the 5th from the Ascendant signifies their drink. If it is a common sign, their drink will be varied. And if Jupiter or Mercury be in it, their drink will be various kinds of wine. And if it be Saturn, it will be made of sugar. And if Mars is in it, their drink will be very sharp, made from dates. If, however, Mars is impeded by Saturn: their drink has already been made bitter. And if it be the Sun: there will be bitterness and sharpness in it. And if it be Venus, they will drink much date-wine. If, however, it be the Moon, their drink will be water. 

And the 6th from the Ascendant: signifies the servants. And the 7th from the Ascendant will be the cupbearers. The 8th: the bakers and cooks. And the 9th: he who serves the dishes. The 10th signifies the goodness of the food: and whether he rejoices with the guests or not; for when a fortune is in the "middle of heaven" <term>Medium Coeli or Midheaven: the highest point in the chart</term>, he will rejoice with them. And if there be "evils" in it: they will be hateful to him and his friends. And the 11th signifies brothers and friends. The 12th signifies the master of the house: and whether he desires it or not. Look, therefore, at the location of the fortunes and the evils in these 12 places; in whichever sign a fortune is found and its lord is fortunate: judge for him that which pertains to that house as good and joyful; and in whichever an evil is found or its lord is impeded: it destroys everything pertaining to that house and all its affairs.

### On the designations of the planetary hours in interrogations.

**Of the Sun:** three petitions of the hours. The first is divided into three parts. He who comes in the **first part of the hour of the Sun** asks about a king or a lord or a man or a great evil from which he has fear; in the **middle**: either for fear or for a sick person; at the **end**: for his livelihood or for trading and taking.

**In the first part of the hour of Venus:** he asks about a matter concerning the capture of a woman or the cares of women. In the **middle**: for the clothing of women or their ornaments. At the **end**: for a cause that is being born or a friendship that cannot be made.

**In the first part of the hour of Mercury:** for a lawsuit or a grandfather; or a carved cause. In the **middle**: for suitable clothing or for the soul of the questioner. At the **end**: for a loss.

**In the first part of the hour of the Moon:** for movement from place to place; or for a sick person; or one who has another blemish in her. In the **middle**: for a cause that has left his hand and does not return; or for a man coming from a journey; or a beast; or for a man who is dying. At the **end**: for a completion or a cause that arises from the earth.

**In the first part of the hour of Saturn:** for his fugitive, if he is weary for his return. In the **middle**: for a strong man or a partnership he wishes to make, or he wants to walk from place to place, or regarding some petition. At the **end**: for an evil cause from which he has already escaped.

**In the first part of the hour of Jupiter:** he comes to ask you about a name or some fame. In the **middle**: for the fitting of a garment; or for the healing of a sick person. At the **end**: for a man who was profiting and now loses his wealth.

**In the first part of the hour of Mars:** first, a bloody theft <note>original: "latrocinium rubeum," literally a 'red theft'</note>; or gold, or brass, or clothing. In the **middle**: either for a sick person greatly afflicted or for heat. At the **end**: for deception or a cause that works in fire.

#### Here ends the book of Zahel on interrogations.

<column-break/>

### Here begins the book of elections by the same Zahel.

<image-desc>A large historiated initial 'M' depicting a man in robes seated at a desk, likely a scholar or the author Zahel, engaged in study or writing.</image-desc>
The sages have remembered that "elections" <term>Elections: the practice of picking a specific time to start an event to ensure success</term> are weak except for kings; they are right. For even if their elections are weak, their "roots"—that is, their nativities <note>their birth charts</note>—strengthen every weak planet in a journey. For women and merchants and those who follow them, do not elect anything except upon their nativities and the revolutions of their years <note>solar returns</note>, and upon the nativities of their children. For those who are ignorant of these things, let interrogations be taken for them, and let the effect of their affairs be known from them; afterwards, let an election be made for them according to this: because when someone asks about himself, he has already come from his nativity to good or evil. Therefore, he asked you; judge for him according to his interrogation. 

Beware, however, regarding elections. For when will you elect for one whose root <note>birth chart</note> is distracted? Especially since this is the first beginning and the ancient root in which there is trust. Beware, therefore, of electing for one whose root of nativity or interrogation has signified something horrible; for when he reaches that point, even if you place all the fortunes in the "angles" and make all the evils "fall" from him, it will profit him nothing. And every planet that does not agree with the Lord of his Ascendant will not profit that man at all, especially those who are lowly or mediocre; for you do not know whether you elect an Ascendant or a star that is an enemy to him in his root, or if there was an evil in that same rising sign you chose for him. 

For we wonder at nothing in those who go to sea, or those who travel in the same hour whose intention is for one journey. If some of them suffer shipwreck, while others escape; and some of them find wealth, while others find nothing: it is not that the state of some of them is the state of others. I have already tested this many times in a comparison of some who departed from a place in one hour and reached another region in one hour. Some of them returned quickly with the best wealth, and some delayed there. Some of them died before they could return to their homes. This happened to them from their nativities and from the diversity of those years. 

We see also some rejoicing and drinking on an evil day, and on a fearful day—that is, a day of many impediments—while a quarrel gathers and enters upon them on a good and laudable day. And you will perhaps see the significator joined to an evil from the 4th aspect or opposition, or it will be with him in one sign, yet he finds good fortune in it. This is only because the malefic planet happened to agree with him more, because it was the Lord of his first Ascendant, or the Lord of his "division," or the Lord of the Ascendant of the revolution of the year. When, however, you choose based on the Ascendant of the interrogation or the nativity which you know, or upon the Lord of the sign of the perfection of the year, your election will be more worthy, because you will know what is suitable for him from the stars and what is his disposition. Beware, therefore, in this matter; let your work be a silent election for yourself. 

And know that the Almighty and Most High created every creature—namely the world and whatever is in it—from the four natures, that is, from the four elements. And He placed the earth and all that is upon it, both rational and irrational, and things mobile and immobile, within a circle. And He placed between the earth and the circle a subtle thing, which the wise know; like that subtle occasion He placed between the lodestone and iron, and which is between a father and son, and between the eater and the food. Know this and understand it: from the concord that exists between both substances—namely the superior and the inferior—they temper things, and by adversity they destroy. And the fortunes are equal—that is, of a tempered nature—but the evils are of a harmful nature. Therefore they wish to hinder, and if they receive [the influence], yet their substance and the quality of their diversity will not be entirely lacking. They are as if thieves and citizens of evil among men, and from them comes diversity and discord, change, and the confusion of things. Understand all of this.

### The Ascendant and what is in it regarding elections in the science of the natures of signs, of which the first are "movable."

<image-desc>A historiated initial 'S' depicting a seated scholar wearing a hat and robes, holding a book, representative of the instructional nature of the text "Scito" (Know).</image-desc>
**Know** that movable signs <term>Movable signs: Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn; also known as Cardinal signs</term> signify the mobility of things quickly, and nothing durable is made in them, nor for a long time. It is only good to sow in them, to buy, to sell, and to confirm a woman <note>likely referring to marriage or a contract</note>; all these things prosper under them. And a sick person will be liberated quickly; a lawsuit in them is not prolonged, and a fugitive will return quickly. Travel also is useful in them. And if someone promises something in them, the promise will not be fulfilled. Talk, dreams, and rumors in them will be false. No physician should run <note>start a treatment</note> under them, nor should any plantation be planted under them, and no foundation should be laid in them, for it is evil; and everything you begin in them for which you desire stability will not be stable. However, every unstable work and work of haste that you wish to do, begin under them, for they are swift.

<summary>This page details how planetary positions and hours govern daily life, from the success of a dinner party to the outcome of specific questions. It also introduces the principles of "electional astrology," emphasizing that picking the right time must be balanced against an individual's birth chart.</summary>

# On elections

<column-break/>

Aries and Cancer are among the more **movable** signs: for they have more "tortuosity" <note>original: "tortuositatis," referring to the irregular way signs rise over the horizon at certain latitudes</note> and more mobility. Libra and Capricorn, however, are stronger and more temperate. Furthermore, **fixed** signs are suitable for any work where stability and a long duration of time are sought, and where the author of the work wishes it to be durable. It is good and useful to build in them and to celebrate marriages—provided the proposal was made in movable signs. However, if a woman is sent away by her husband while the Moon is in a fixed sign, she will not return to him. In the beginnings and commencements of tasks, there will be no confidence in these signs unless the testimonies of the "fortunes" <note>the benefic planets, Jupiter and Venus</note> are multiplied. Whoever is conquered in them will have their imprisonment prolonged, and whoever becomes angry in them cannot be quickly appeased. Agreements and wages are useful in them, and it will be good to build and lay a foundation. Scorpio is the lightest of all the fixed signs, and Leo the most fixed. Aquarius is slower and worse, while Taurus is more level and plain.

**Common** signs <term>Common signs: Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces, which sit between the seasons</term> are useful for partnerships and brotherhood. And whatever work is done in them will often be repeated. Buying and celebrating marriages in them will not be useful or profitable, and there will be trickery and deception in them. Whoever has something thrown against them <note>perhaps an accusation or a physical object</note> in these signs will escape and be healed from it. Whoever is imprisoned in them is only held in fear because of the brevity of their appearance and their eventual exit; and whoever leaves a prison will return to his original place. If a fugitive is captured in them, he will return to his flight. Whoever goes before a judge in these signs will have no firm sentence or judgment established, nor should anyone travel in a ship in them. For whoever travels will be moved from that ship to another. To whom anything is promised in these signs, the promise is dissolved and nothing of it is completed. The sick are healed in them, though they may run into a relapse. Everything that happens to a man in these signs, whether good or evil, is doubled upon him; if someone dies in them, then another will die after him in that same place. Changing and washing the head and beard, the refining of gold and silver, and sending children to study letters <note>meaning to begin their education</note> are all favorable in these signs.

If you wish to begin any of those things I have told you, then place the Moon in the Ascendant <term>Ascendant: the sign rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of the start</term> of those houses favorable to what you desire. Support the Moon with the "fortunes" receiving her in that sign. The signs of the day are stronger in comparison to the day, so set the Ascendant of the day accordingly.

**Aery** signs are favorable for hunting on land and sea; **royal** signs are favorable for kings. Signs that have **voices** <note>certain signs like Gemini, Virgo, Libra, and the first half of Sagittarius were considered "vocal" or human-voiced</note> are favorable for those who play the flute with a raw sound, for the voice of white people <note>original: "voci alboorum," possibly referring to a specific vocal quality or group</note>, and for songs. **Fiery** signs are favorable for everything done with fire. Signs of **equality**, in which night and day are equal <note>the equinoctial signs, Aries and Libra</note>, are favorable for measurement and truth-telling, and for those who work with scales. **Mutable** signs—those in which night and day begin to change—are favorable for transformation, and for one who wishes to return to a matter through change. Consider for every work you wish to begin what the nature of that sign is from the orbits. Support the Moon and the Lord of the Ascendant with that substance, and the root of that nature and virtue at that hour—that is, the hour of the beginning.

If you desire something concerning the part of lords, princes, magnates, and those who rule over cities, and notable people and masters, or of battles and weariness: then look to the **Sun**. What concerns the part of the sublime: look to **Jupiter**. For farmers and the lowest people: look to **Saturn**. For chains and the masters of battles: look to **Mars**. What concerns the part of women: look to **Venus**. Purchases, sales, protections, written matters, and business negotiations: these belong to **Mercury**. In the mixture of queens among women and their ingestion: these are governed by the **Moon**.

### ¶ Election for the beginning of any work: and on the ten impediments of the moon.

Therefore, when you wish to begin any work: arrange the Ascendant and its Lord, as well as the Moon and the Lord of that matter. Beware of the "impediments of the Moon," as Dorotheus and the other wise men said regarding the beginning of works; there are ten ways.

1.  The first way is if she is **combust** <term>Combust: within 12 degrees of the Sun, which "burns" the planet's power</term> before the Sun by 12 degrees, and similarly after it. However, it is lighter after the Sun.
2.  Second, if she is in the degree of her **descent** <note>her "Fall," which for the Moon is in Scorpio</note>.
3.  Third, if she is in **opposition** to the Sun.
4.  Fourth, if she is joined to the "evils" <note>the malefic planets Mars or Saturn</note>, or in the light of their fourth aspect <note>a square aspect, 90 degrees</note> or opposition.
5.  Fifth, if she is at the **Head or Tail** <note>the Lunar Nodes, where eclipses occur</note>, from the degree up to 12 degrees, which is the limit of an eclipse.
6.  Sixth, if she is in the **final degrees** of the signs, which are the "terms" of the malefics.
7.  Seventh, if she is **cadent** <term>Cadent: falling away from the powerful "angles" or corners of the chart</term> from the angles, or in the **Combust Way** <note>original: "via combusta," a section of the zodiac (late Libra to early Scorpio) considered unlucky</note>. This is the worst of the impediments of the Moon, especially if the beginning concerns a marriage, or anything regarding women, or buying, selling, or a pilgrimage.
8.  Eighth, if she is in the 7th sign from her own house <note>the sign of Capricorn, which is opposite the Moon's home, Cancer</note> with a malefic; or if she is in opposition to her own house or not "looking at" it <note>not making an astrological aspect</note>.

<column-break/>

9.  Ninth, if the Moon is **slower in her course**; this is what the wise men call the "likeness of the course of Saturn," when her daily course is less than 12 degrees. Even if it is only one minute less, it is counted as such if her daily course is less than the average daily course written in the "canon"—that is, in that book of planetary motions.
10. The tenth, which **Messahallach** <note>Masha'allah ibn Athari (c. 740–815), a Persian Jewish astrologer and astronomer</note> and the wise men of our time mentioned, is when the Moon is **void of course** <term>Void of course: when the Moon makes no more major aspects before leaving its current sign</term>.

Arrange the Moon as best as you can. Do not place her in the Ascendant for anyone, for this is to be feared because of what might happen to that person's master from infirmities in the body—unless it is the Lord of the Ascendant or a "fortune" looking at the degree of the Ascendant. For a planet that does not look at its own house is like a man absent from his home who can neither repel anything from it nor prevent anything. When, however, a planet beholds its own house, it is like the master of the house who guards it. For everyone who is inside the house fears him, and he who is outside fears to come into it.

If the Lord of the Ascendant is malefic, make him look upon it from a trine or sextile aspect. Beware of placing the Moon in the angles when she is impeded. Instead, place the "fortunes" in the angles of the Ascendant, or the Moon when two fortunes are looking at her from an angle and you have placed her in the angles of the Ascendant. Do not make the "Part of Fortune" <term>Part of Fortune: a mathematical point in the chart representing prosperity</term> cadent in any beginnings or interrogations from the aspect of the Moon or its conjunction. Do not look at the Lord of the Part of Fortune, nor care if that part is cadent from the Ascendant. And if it is that same part, strive to place the Lord of the Ascendant with the father <note>original: "cum patre," likely referring to the Sun or a paternal significator</note>, for this is more useful and of greater profit. Never place the Moon in the 2nd, 6th, 8th, or 12th house from the part, for this is horrible.

Always establish the Ascendant and the Moon in all beginnings in signs of **direct ascension**, for this signifies ease and progress; do not place them in signs of **tortuous ascension**, for this signifies complication and slowness. The Ascendant and the 4th house from it signify what will happen to that election. Therefore, look to the fortunes and the malefics in those places, and whether they are strong or weak; and speak upon the beginning of that matter, and its ends based on that strength and weakness. **Dorotheus** <note>Dorotheus of Sidon, a 1st-century astrological poet</note> said that when you see the Moon impeded and a matter must be done and cannot be deferred, do not give the Moon a place in the Ascendant; rather, make her cadent from the Ascendant, and place a "fortune" in the Ascendant, strengthening the Ascendant and its Lord.

### ¶ The Second Sign or the Second House with its elections. And first, on receiving and lending money.

When you wish to choose an hour for the receiving and lending of money: let the Moon be in Leo, Pisces, Scorpio, Sagittarius, or Aquarius. Let her be waning in light, and let both "fortunes" be waning and looking at the Moon or the Ascendant. Let **Mercury** be clean from **Mars**, and the Moon with **Jupiter** or Mercury. Beware that the Moon is not impeded by any malefic, nor that Mercury be joined to them or in the 4th aspect <note>square</note> to them. Nor should the fortunes be cadent. For if the Moon is with Mars, the matter will fall into labor, anxiety, negotiation, and hardship. If she is impeded by **Saturn**, it will fall into prolongation and delay, and it will result in restriction and fatigue.

If, however, you wish to **hide** that same loan so that no one can perceive it: let the Moon, while you receive or seek it, be under the rays of the Sun, going toward a conjunction of the fortunes after her separation from the Sun. This is the most hidden way of all, and you will not be made public. For if the Moon is at her exit from combustion, going toward a conjunction with Mars, it will be made public and you will fall into the hour of those people whom you do not want to know about it. Beware that the Moon is not in the circle of the signs without latitude—that is, in the Head or Tail <note>the Nodes</note>—or in the **Combust Way**, for this is horrible. Dorotheus said: do not receive a loan nor lend anything to anyone while the Moon is in the part of Leo, Gemini, or Sagittarius, or if these signs are ascending; for this is hateful to the lending of property. Know this.

### ¶ Election for partnership with someone in property or any work.

And if you wish to enter a partnership with someone in property or work: it is better for this that the Moon be clean from the malefics and joined to the fortunes. Let her be in "common" signs so that their profit may be multiplied; or let the Moon be in Leo or Taurus. It is a source of dread for them if the Moon is in the inferior signs; it is worse...

<meta>The catchword "deterioꝛ" (worse) indicates the text continues on the next page describing the negative outcomes of certain placements.</meta>

# Zabel <note>This is a Latinized form of Sahl ibn Bishr, a famous 9th-century Jewish astrologer and mathematician whose works were foundational to medieval European astrology.</note>

For others, Libra is the balance: because the "burnt path" <note>original: "via combusta," a region of the zodiac (traditionally late Libra to early Scorpio) considered unlucky or "debilitated" for the Moon</note> is in it. Similarly, Aquarius is dreadful unless the Moon is received in a trine or sextile aspect: so that there may be a good separation between them: because in a square aspect or opposition, there will be "talk" between them—that is, a quarrel—during the separation. An aspect of love <note>The "aspects of love" are the sextile and trine, which were considered harmonious.</note> signifies goodness or the honesty of their separation, as well as their loyalty and benevolence. ¶ And beware of the presence of the "malics" <term>Malics: the planets Mars and Saturn, traditionally associated with hardship and disruption</term> in the angles <note>The "angles" are the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses of a chart, the most powerful positions.</note>: because the one in the Ascendant represents the person beginning the partnership, or whoever is older. The seventh house represents the other partner. The tenth signifies what will happen between them, and the abundance or poverty of profit; from the fourth house, however, the final outcome of their business is known. And beware lest the lord of the Ascendant does not "look upon" <note>An astrological term meaning the planet does not form a geometric aspect with that house.</note> the Ascendant, or the lord of the Moon's house does not look upon the Moon: for if it is so, each of them will deceive his partner and their affairs will worsen during the separation.

¶ Election for sending wealth so that profit may be made from it.
**And if you wish** to send wealth for the sake of profit: prepare the Moon and Mercury and the lord of the house of wealth; also the lord of the degree of the "house of trust" <note>likely referring to the 11th house of hopes and friends</note>: and let the Moon be joined to Mercury. Make Mars "fall" <term>Fall: to place a planet in a weak house where it cannot exert influence, usually away from the "angles."</term> from both of them as much as you can. Also, prepare Mercury and cleanse it of its "vices" <note>astrological debilities like being retrograde or combust</note>. But if Mercury is retrograde, prepare the Moon and the degree of the lord of the house of trust and their lords: and make Mercury fall from the light of Mars: and do not make it fall from the aspect of Venus, or from the lord of the eleventh. And let your trust always be in the direct movement of the wealth and the seeking of profit through Mercury, the Moon, and the degree of the house of trust and their lords: and make Mars and his light fall from them.

¶ Election for buying and selling.
**And if you wish** to choose an hour for buying: prepare the Part of Fortune: and let it be in the houses of Jupiter joined to the "fortunes" <term>Fortunes: the benefic planets, Jupiter and Venus.</term>: because this will be better for the buyer than the seller. And when the Moon is in signs of "direct ascension" <note>Signs that take longer to rise over the horizon (in the northern hemisphere: Cancer through Sagittarius), considered more stable.</note>, increasing in light and number <note>Waxing in illumination and moving faster in its orbit.</note> and joined to the fortunes: whatever the lord buys in that hour, he will lose in it: and this is better for the buyer than the seller. Let Mars be falling from the Moon and Mercury: because Mars hinders buying and selling: and he is the one who signifies labor and contention. Similarly, the Tail <term>The Tail: "Cauda Draconis" or the South Node of the Moon, considered a point of depletion and bad luck.</term>: make it fall from the Moon specifically: it is ranked below Mars. And if you wish to sell, place the Moon in its exaltation or triplicity, separated from the fortunes and looking toward the malics: but let it not be joined to them.

¶ Election for the works of alchemy.
**And if you wish** to practice alchemy or any work that you wish to repeat, let it be done thus: let the Moon be in common signs, clean of the malics: and let the Ascendant be similar. Prepare them therefore. And if your work is in gold, strengthen the Sun: and prepare it at the beginning of the work.

¶ The 3rd sign or 3rd house with its elections.
<image-desc>Decorative drop cap 'E' featuring a seated scholar in a robe reading at a desk or lectern.</image-desc>
**Whatever** falls in the third sign concerning elections, part of it is in the ninth: and the other part is in the house of friends <note>the 11th house</note>: then we shall speak of it, if God wills.

¶ The 4th sign or 4th house: and whatever is in it regarding elections: and first for building a house.
<image-desc>Decorative drop cap 'C' containing a profile view of a human head surrounded by ornamental vine and leaf patterns.</image-desc>
**When you wish** to choose a time to build a house: prepare the Moon and its lord, and the degree of the Ascendant and its lord: also the Part of Fortune and Mercury: and make Mars fall from these significators which I have named for you: and never give him a part in any of the building of houses. And if it cannot be helped that he has a part: place Venus strongly in her place: and do not give her strength over Mars: and join her to him in a trine or sextile aspect: because Mars does not hinder the affairs of Venus due to the greatness of his friendship toward her: and make Saturn fall from Venus as much as you can because of his enmity toward Mars and with the Moon when they look upon each other with love <note>i.e., in a good aspect</note>: and let the Moon be increasing in light and number: and joined to Jupiter in a square aspect <note>original: "ex 4o aspectu"</note>: because it is better than an opposition: and this signifies the beauty of the building and its perfection. And beware lest the Moon be with Saturn

<column-break/>

or the Tail <note>the Dragon's Tail</note>: or let Saturn not be in the Ascendant or the 4th: because this signifies slowness and hardship in the work: and because they will not be built; or if it is built or inhabited, the inhabitants will not cease to suffer fears and infirmities and labors and tribulations from death in it, and the building will be cracked: and perhaps it will fall. And if Mars looks upon it: and the Ascendant is in the circle of the "Auge" <note>original: "augis," referring to the apogee or the highest point of a planet's orbit</note> or a short circle, fire and collapse are feared for it: and let the Moon then be increasing in light: because it will then be useful to its master. And let the lord of the Moon's house be looking upon it. Similarly, let the lord of the Ascendant be looking upon the Ascendant, and let it be clean from the malics: because if they do not look upon it, the master will not dwell in it.

¶ Election for destroying a house.
**And when you wish** to destroy a house, let this be when the Moon descends in its circle and is separated from the malics and joined to the fortunes: and let that fortune be oriental <note>Rising in the east before the Sun.</note> or let the Ascendant be direct, or let the Moon be joined to the lord of its house out of love—that is, in a trine or sextile aspect—so that its destruction may be easier: in a square aspect or opposition, the destruction will be harder for them.

¶ Election for buying land or leasing it so that you may receive income from it.
**And if you wish** to buy lands and enter into them with someone: or you wish to have land so that you may receive its income from someone, let Saturn be in his exaltation: or in his triplicity or term: and let Jupiter be in his aspect from an angle or a trine aspect: and make Mars fall from them: and let the Moon be at the beginning of the month looking upon Saturn out of love, increased in number also in the aspect of Jupiter: for this signifies the population of that land and its revenue. And if you cannot have the aspect of Jupiter with Saturn: place Venus in the place of Jupiter: and make the agricultural signs <note>Signs like Taurus, Virgo, and Capricorn (earth signs).</note> fortunate: because when you make them fortunate with the "fortunes," they will be better than the airy signs: and let the Moon be in its exaltation or in the Midheaven: and let the lord of the Ascendant look upon it: also let the Moon and the Ascendant be clean from malics and from vices.

¶ Election for leading a spring or digging a well.
**And when you wish** to lead a river or dig a well or channels: let it be when Saturn is oriental: and the Moon is under the earth <note>Below the horizon.</note> in the 3rd or 5th house, free from the malics, fortunate and received: and beware lest any of the malics be in the Midheaven: because it is then to be feared that the well might collapse, or the channel or the river might fail. And let Saturn be in the 11th from the Ascendant: and let the Moon be joined to a fortune in a fixed sign: the Ascendant in the circle is better for the fortunes: and Jupiter. And if you cannot do this, place the fortunes in the Midheaven: because in this way the river is more durable and the channel or well more stable.

¶ Election for planting trees.
**And if you wish** to plant palms and fig trees and other trees, let it be when the Moon is in a fixed sign: and the lord of its house looks upon it from the water signs: and let the Ascendant be a fixed sign or a common one: and the lord of the Ascendant rising and oriental: because if he is rising and not oriental, they will grow more quickly. But they will delay in bearing fruit. And if he is oriental and descending, they will grow slowly and bear fruit quickly. And if he is occidental and descending, both the growth and the fruit will be delayed. And let the lord of the Ascendant and the lord of the Moon's house be looking upon them, and let them be free from the malics and from combustion <term>Combustion: when a planet is so close to the Sun that its power is "burnt up" and weakened.</term>.

¶ Election for sowing seed.
**And when you wish** to sow seed that you wish to cultivate further, let the Ascendant be a common sign: and its lord in a movable sign looking upon the lord of its house: and let him be free from the malics: because if a malic looks upon him, he will find the seed itself hindered. Let the Moon therefore be increased in light and number: because if the Moon is under the rays <note>Within 15 degrees of the Sun, but not "combust" (closer than 8 degrees).</note> and is deficient in light and number, the seed itself will vanish and nothing will grow from it. And if the Moon is as I told you before, increased in number: that seed will grow thin according to the quantity of that which is sown.

<header>On Elections</header>
