<meta>This page continues the astrological teachings of Masha'allah ibn Athari, shifting from the general omens of eclipses discussed on the previous page to the technical methods of calculating the "Revolution of the Years of the World"—the annual forecast based on the sun's entry into Aries.</meta>

->Of the revolutions of the years 137<-

### Here begins the book of Masha'allah on the revolutions of the years of the world.

<image-desc>Historiated woodcut initial 'C' showing a scholar seated at a desk, possibly Messahallah himself.</image-desc>
May God guard you, and increase your life, and reveal to you—may God exalt you—the revolution of the years of the world. <note>original: "reuolutiōē ānoꝝ mundi"</note> The knowledge and disposition of this is: that you should know when the sun enters the first minute of the sign of Aries <note>The Vernal Equinox, which medieval astrologers considered the "New Year" for the entire world.</note>. When you know this, you shall establish the <term>ascendant</term> <note>The degree of the zodiac rising on the eastern horizon at that exact moment.</note> and the four <term>angles</term> <note>The four most powerful points of a chart: the Ascendant, Midheaven, Descendant, and Imum Coeli.</note> and the locations of the planets through their degrees, and their state according to the order of the circle: namely, by their direct motion, their <term>retrogradation</term> <note>When a planet appears to move backward in the sky, usually interpreted as a sign of weakness or delay.</note> and slowness, the transits of some over others, their elevation, their magnitude and latitude, and the projection of their rays. Know that a retrograde planet has no strength to do good until it returns to direct motion. After this, look at the ascendant and the <term>lord of the exaltation</term> <note>A planet that has a special "honorary" strength in a specific sign.</note> of the ascendant, and the lord of the <term>term</term> <note>A sub-division of a zodiac sign ruled by a specific planet.</note> and the lord of the <term>triplicity</term> <note>A group of three signs belonging to the same element—Fire, Earth, Air, or Water.</note>, and the location of the lord of the hour relative to the ascendant. See what kind of places they are in: whether they are in a place of enmity to the ascendant or a place of friendship. For if the lord of the ascendant is an enemy to the ascendant, it signifies harm to that <term>climate</term> <note>A geographic zone of the earth, as defined by ancient and medieval latitude systems.</note> according to the degree of enmity. If it is in the 6th house, there will be sickness; if in the 8th, death; and if in the 12th, enmity according to the nature of the lord of the sign in which the lord of the ascendant resides. Similarly, consider the lord of the term, the lord of the exaltation, and the lord of the triplicity, though their influence is less than the lord of the ascendant. After this, look at the locations of the <term>luminaries</term> <note>The Sun and the Moon.</note> from the ascendant and from the lord of the ascendant. Because if the revolution occurs during the day, and the Sun aspects the ascendant or its lord, and the Sun is free from <term>malefics</term> <note>Saturn and Mars.</note>, it signifies strength and the attainment of victory for the citizens of that climate. It is even better if the Sun touches the disposition of the lord of the ascendant and is <term>received</term> <note>A technical term for when a planet is in a sign or dignity of another planet, suggesting mutual support.</note> in the place where it resides. If it is as we have said, the rulers and powers of that climate will be humbled and subject to the lord of that climate, and prosperity, peace, and health will be granted to them by the will of God. The Moon works similarly to the Sun if the revolution occurs at night. When the lords of the luminaries, or one of them, aspects them from a strong place and they receive them, there will be no harm to men nor any commotion; instead, they will be secure and quiet, seeking justice and judging by it. If it is the opposite, then say the contrary: namely, turn the good things we said into evil. After this, look at the "reception" of the planets with one another and their enmity in various parts, and predict according to what you see for the lands and regions in which they are located. Know that a sign signifies a part of the world by its nature, not just by its location; if the nature of the sign matches the region, its effect is stronger. Aries and its triplicity <note>The Fire signs: Aries, Leo, Sagittarius.</note> are signs of the East; if they reach the ascendant, their significance is stronger. Taurus and its triplicity <note>The Earth signs: Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn.</note> are signs of the South; when they match the signs of the Midheaven, their significance is stronger. Gemini and its triplicity <note>The Air signs: Gemini, Libra, Aquarius.</note> are signs of the West; when they match the signs of the western angle, their significance is stronger. Cancer and its triplicity <note>The Water signs: Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces.</note> and the northern signs, when they match the angle of the earth <note>The Imum Coeli, or the bottom of the chart.</note>, their significance is stronger. We say this when many planets are in these places as described. Know that the lands have two divisions: East and South are one, because they agree in heat; West and North are the other, because they agree in cold. After this, the earth is divided into seven divisions <note>The Seven Climates.</note> according to the seven planets, following the order of the celestial spheres. For the first climate is of Saturn, the 2nd of Jupiter, the 3rd of Mars, the 4th of the Sun, the 5th of Venus, the 6th of Mercury, and the 7th of the Moon. These climates follow the nature of the spheres. Furthermore, there is a specific sign and planet known for each land and city. This is also true of the "terms"; for perhaps a city belongs to a certain sign, but the "term" of another planet within that sign dominates it. For example <note>original: "vbi gꝛa" for "verbi gratia"</note>, Al-Iraq <note>original: "alirac"</note> is said to belong to Cancer, and its planet is Jupiter. This is because the location of Al-Iraq corresponds to the 19th through the 27th degree of Cancer, which is the "term" of Jupiter.

<column-break/>

The descent of <term>fortunes</term> <note>Benefic planets like Jupiter and Venus.</note> into this place signifies the specific desires and success of the citizens of Al-Iraq; and likewise, the descent of "evils" <note>Malefic planets like Saturn and Mars.</note> signifies misfortune. You will know this similarly from the descent of fortunes and evils in other "terms," as I have already explained to you. Understand this well, just as I told you: for when you do this, it will not be hidden from you which sign or term a city belongs to. After this, look at whether the ascending sign is fixed, mobile <note>Also called "cardinal."</note>, or common <note>Also called "mutable."</note>. Look also at the "Lord of the Year." For when the ascendant of the year is a mobile sign, quarterly revolutions within the year are necessary—even more so if the Lord of the Year is in a mobile sign. If it is a common sign, only two revolutions are necessary: namely, at the head of Aries and Libra. Do this for all the quarters of the year based on the mobile signs. But when a fixed sign is ascending, the revolution of the year rules over all the quarters; and this is even stronger if the Lord is in a fixed sign. If the Lord of the Year is in a mobile sign, there will be abundance or scarcity as signified in the first quarter of the year only, unless it also appears in the second, third, or fourth quarter; the distinction will then be according to what that specific quarter signifies regarding abundance and scarcity.

### Chapter on the knowledge of the Lord of the Year.

<image-desc>Historiated woodcut initial 'C' showing a profile view of a head within decorative foliage.</image-desc>
When you wish to know the Lord of the Year, look at the hour of the revolution for the planet that is stronger than the others in its location and has the most "testimony" <note>A technical term for the number of planetary dignities (like being in its own sign, exaltation, etc.) a planet possesses.</note>; appoint it the Lord of the Year in the climate where it resides. After this, consider the seven climates as I previously told you regarding the seven planets. I will now explain to you the "worth" of the planets and their testimonies so you may know the Lord of the Year. Know that the strongest of the planets is the one in the ascendant that is neither "remote" nor "falling" <note>Planets in the "cadent" or weak houses (3, 6, 9, 12).</note>, or one in the Midheaven. A planet in the descendant or the "angle of the earth" <note>The 4th house.</note> has a strength a quarter less than what I just told you. The 11th sign is below the descendant and the angle of the earth; the 9th is below the 11th; the 5th is below the 9th; and the 3rd is below the 5th. When the lord of the ascendant is in the ascendant and is not falling or remote from the ascending angle, it is not necessary to look at any other planet. Similarly, the lord of the exaltation when it is in the degrees of its exaltation, or the lord of the triplicity when it is in the ascendant or Midheaven, shall have a third of the strength of the lord of the ascendant. The lord of the term has a fifth part of the strength, according to their power in the signs, and the lord of the hour has a seventh part of the "worth." Know that this applies when they are in the ascendant or Midheaven. If they are in the West <note>The Descendant.</note> or the angle of the earth, their strength is diminished; likewise, in the 11th, 9th, and 5th houses, their strength is reduced. Know that if the luminaries are in any of the "angles," they shall be the Lords of the Year unless the one in the angle is "impeded" <note>Afflicted by a bad aspect or a malefic planet.</note>. If it is impeded, it signifies hardship and weakness for that climate. It is better if the Sun is in an angle during the day, or the Moon is in an angle at night. Similarly, nocturnal planets thrive at night, and diurnal ones thrive during the day. Therefore, when you work with the revolutions of the years, begin by determining the strength as I have told you.

### Chapter on when the Lord of the Year commits his disposition to another.

<image-desc>Historiated woodcut initial 'C' with a human figure integrated into the letter form.</image-desc>
When the Lord of the Year is clear to you, see if it perhaps "commits its disposition" to another. This happens when it is in the house of a planet and that planet is in an excellent location from the ascendant, and the Lord of the Year is joined to it. If this is so, the lord of that house becomes the Lord of the Year because it receives the other planet from its house. This is even better if the luminaries or the lords of their houses aspect it. But if it does not commit its disposition to the lord of its house, see if its own strength in its location is sufficient for the disposition. Its strength is as I showed you in the first chapter. When planets are joined to the Lord of the Year and commit their disposition to it, joy will come to that climate from every side, proportional to the disposition. When the luminaries commit their disposition to the lord of the ascendant, or even one of them does so, you will not need to look at anything else, for he is the Lord of the Year without doubt. Look also at the peasants <note>original: "rusticis"</note> and their condition from the Lord of the Year and his location, and from the aspect of the planets to him.

### Chapter on the significator of the king and his subjects.

You shall look to the king of the region <note>original: "regi climatis"</note> by the union of the Midheaven <note>The 10th house, representing authority and government.</note> and the Sun, and from both of these: namely, from the conjunction and separation of the planets from them. You shall choose the stronger between the Sun and the Lord of the Midheaven according to their strength; you shall set the one chosen as the <term>significator</term> <note>A planet that represents a specific person or thing in a chart.</note> of the king. When you have identified the significator of the king, it will not be hidden from you how he and his commoners <note>original: "rusticis"</note> shall fare regarding good and evil, and whatever he shall find in that same year regarding distribution, distinction, and abundance, or scarcity—by God's will—concerning every matter: that is, of his empire, his commoners, his wealth, and also his children and wives, his health and sickness, his travels, his strength and weakness, and his death. Know that this chapter concerning the king is more specific than the chapter on the Lord of the Year and the state of the commoners, because you look to the king individually, but to the commoners universally. 

When you have identified the Lord of the Year and the significator of the king of that region, look to see who "looks at" <note>An "aspect," or geometric relationship between planets.</note> him, and what the strength of the one looking at him is, and whether he is "in his light"—that is, when he has emerged from under the Sun's rays <note>A planet is "combust" or weakened when too close to the Sun; "in his light" means it is far enough away to be visible and strong.</note>—and whether he is joined to no one or is in the light of another. It is necessary to look at the locations of those who might be a strong Lord of the Year, needing nothing; I shall explain to you how this will be when the Lord of the Year is "falling" <note>Cadent houses (the 3rd, 6th, 9th, and 12th) were considered weak because they do not support the Ascendant.</note> from the ascendant, not looking at the ascendant from the 8th, 6th, 2nd, or 12th houses; then he is in need, and thus weakness happens to him because he has fallen into a remote place. Therefore, he requires a planet to which he may be joined, which might return his light to the Midheaven and strengthen him. For when a planet has many "testimonies" <note>A term for various sources of astrological strength or authority over a specific degree of the zodiac.</note> and is the Lord of the Year, but is in the 8th house, then he needs a planet to look at him from the Midheaven. Every planet that does not look at the ascendant looks at the Midheaven by a <term>trine</term> or <term>sextile</term> aspect, except for one that is in the 3rd house, which is weakened and does not look. If the planet in the Midheaven is strong and is the lord of the house of the Lord of the Year—to whom the testimonies are joined—and the Lord of the Year itself is joined to it, it will receive the disposition of the year and its signification, and it shall be the Lord of the Year. I have already explained this chapter to you at the beginning of this book, and how it will be comforted in its place by the lord of its house or by another. After this, look at the one who looks at the Lord of the Year and pronounce what it signifies according to the quality of the place, whether good or evil; if it is strong, it signifies strongly; if it is weak, it signifies weakly.

### Chapter on the significations of the aspects, the Lord of the Year, and the remaining significators.

Know that the aspect of <term>opposition</term> signifies enmity, and conjunctions and <term>squares</term> <note>An aspect of 90 degrees, usually considered stressful or challenging.</note> do likewise. However, the <term>trine</term> and <term>sextile</term> aspects signify friendship. When an evil planet <note>A "malefic" planet, usually Saturn or Mars.</note> looks at the significator of the year or the significator of the kingdom from an opposition, the hindrance itself will come from enemies. If it looks from a square aspect, it will be from certain people who are thought to be peaceful, because the enmity was more hidden. If it is from a trine or sextile aspect, it will be from friends. After this, look to see whether that hindrance falls back upon the king or upon the commoners. If it enters upon the king, look to see whether the commoners help him or not; if it enters upon the commoners, see whether the king helps them or not. After this, look at the house in which the evil planet resides; if the significator of the king or the Lord of the Year has any testimony in it, there will be enmity from his own region according to the amount of his testimony. Look also if perhaps the Lord of the Year perishes but the significator of the king does not; for if it should be so, there will be an enemy from that same region, but the king is weakened and another is introduced in his place. But if the significator of the king prevails and the Lord of the Year does not, there will be no enemy from his region or his kingdom, but the king will bring them into his dominion and subjugate them. 

When you have finished this, look at the location of the evil planet and from which direction it comes, because the distress itself will come from that same direction, whether from a city or region, or from the region of that same zodiac sign. Know that the age of the leader and princes is known from the location of the evil planet relative to the Sun: if it is <term>oriental</term> <note>Rising in the east before the Sun.</note> he will be young; if it is <term>occidental</term> <note>Setting in the west after the Sun.</note> he will be old. Pronounce upon this what is between them according to the location of the planet, from its conjunction with the Sun until its <term>combustion</term> <note>Being burned up by the Sun's proximity.</note>. Also, when an evil planet is in the Midheaven and it

Know that nothing is worse for the inhabitants of the land and the cities than the sign in which the evil planet resides, especially if it is retrograde in the revolution of the year, and even more so if the evil planet is in an <term>angle</term> <note>One of the four most powerful houses: 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th.</note>. 

After this, look at the evil planet that looks at the Lord of the Year or the significator of the king. When you have done this, look at those who are at peace or at enmity based on the locations of the planets and their aspects: from opposition, square, trine, and sextile, and from the houses from which they look. Know that a planet that is "under the rays" <note>Combust, or hidden by the Sun's glare.</note> is like a patient <note>A sick person or one suffering.</note>. For when it enters under the rays, its strength recedes, and when it emerges from under the rays, it signifies increase and perfection. For when a planet's combustion is frequent, it signifies evil, and especially any planet that is under the Sun when it is the Lord of the Year and the significator of the king, and another evil planet looks at it; then the state of the year and the king will be the worst it can be. 

When the Sun is "under its own rays" in a day-revolution, it is a diurnal planet, and in a night-revolution, a nocturnal planet; it signifies the king, because it then receives the strength of the planets. Look also to the Part of the Year and the significator of the king; if they are hindered, look at them and their locations in the signs, because the Part of Fortune is the strength of the Luminaries. # Of the revolutions of the years

...in the Midheaven; or if he is the Lord of the Exaltation of the Midheaven; or if the Lord of the Midheaven has committed his disposition and strength to him; or if the Lord of the Midheaven is in his own house looking upon him. For when it is thus, the Lord of the Year shall also be the <term>significator</term> of the king. And when you know this in the revolution of the years, you will know the significator of the king from the Lord of the Year. And know that his state shall be that of the **commoners** <note>original: "rusticoꝛ"; literally "peasants" or "country-folk," but here referring to the general population or subjects of the realm.</note>.

But if the Sun is the Lord of the Year, observe as I told you in the third chapter. Also observe the Lord of the Midheaven: if he is under the rays <note>A planet "under the Sun's rays" is weakened by the Sun's proximity.</note>, entering into **combustion**, this signifies the death of the king. And if he has already emerged from combustion but is not yet visible, the Sun will be more worthy than him in signifying the king. 

After this, observe to whom the significator of the king is joined; because when he is joined to the Lord of the Year, he commits his affairs to the commoners. And if he is separated from the Lord of the Year and joined to a malefic <note>The "harmful" planets, Saturn and Mars.</note> or a planet inimical to the Ascendant, he will be suspicious of them and bring harm upon them. And if the significator of the king is joined to any planet in the **8th** or **6th** house by opposition or a **4th aspect** <note>A "square" aspect (90 degrees), traditionally considered a source of tension or conflict.</note>, death is feared for the king in that same year. Similarly, if he is joined to their Lords outside of these places I have mentioned—and even more strongly if they are joined to malefics—sickness shall be feared for him; especially if he is joined to a planet in the **3rd** or **6th** house as I said in the first chapter, or to their Lords. 

Similarly, you shall observe his entire state in this manner; and I say this if the Lord of the Midheaven has committed his disposition to the Lord of the Year. If, however, he has not committed it, the Lord of the Midheaven will be more significant in what I have said. Observe also in the **12 places** <note>The twelve astrological houses.</note> of the regions: regarding distress and abundance, and regarding fear and sadness. Look then to the regions of all climates and parts. 

After this, observe who is the Lord of the house of the Lord of the Year; for if he looks upon him and "receives" him <note>A technical term ("reception") where one planet is in a sign governed by the other, indicating cooperation.</note>, the joy and security of the Lord shall find them. But if he does not look upon him, fear and distress shall find them. If the Lord of the Year commits his disposition to the significator of the king, he shall bring distress upon them for the sake of acquiring wealth, especially when this commission is from a 4th aspect or from opposition. If, however, it is from a **trine** or **sextile** aspect, it signifies the payment of tribute <note>original: "census"</note> without the entry of distress upon the commoners. 

And if he commits his disposition without an aspect, this shall happen without the king’s knowledge. If he looks upon the Lord of his house, the king will extract wealth in that same year; and if he does not look upon him, he will extract wealth against his [the subject's] will. After this, observe the king’s wealth if the significator of the king is the Lord of the Midheaven from the **11th house**. And if he is the Lord of the Year from the **2nd house**; and the state of the soldiers toward the king from the Lord of the sign in which he resides, and from the Lord of the term or face; and assist yourself in this through the **Part of Fortune** <note>A calculated mathematical point in a chart representing prosperity.</note> and its Lords. If the significator of the king looks upon it or is with it, it signifies the king's fortune.

Similarly, observe the commoners from the Lord of the Year; and know the state of the king from his significator, and that of the powerful and noble from the Lord of the Year. For when you have done this, their state will not be hidden from you, nor what will find them in the year of good or evil, and in what manner or by what cause it shall be, if God wills. 

After this, observe the Lord of the Year and the significator of the king: if they are **retrograde** <note>Moving backward in the zodiac; usually signifies weakness, delays, or reversals.</note>, they signify the loss and weakness of the king and of the citizens of that kingdom. If both are retrograde, or one of them, observe in whose **term** <note>A subdivision of a zodiac sign ruled by a specific planet.</note> he is retrograde: namely, whether in the term of a fortune <note>A "benefic" planet like Jupiter or Venus.</note> or a malefic. Apply the same to the Lord of the house; for if a planet is retrograde in a house of fortune, it will be better than in a house of a malefic or in the term of a malefic. For the retrogradation of the significator of the king signifies the weakness of the king, and the retrogradation of the Lord of the Year signifies the weakness of that rule. 

After this, observe war from the part where **Mars** is. If he is direct, it will be from diligent men who do not wish to flee. But if he is retrograde, the war will be with thieves <note>original: "latronibus"</note> who do not rest in one place and will not come to battle. **Saturn**, however, signifies the distress of the citizens of the region in which he resides, according to the substances of the sign in which he is and his place among the houses in succession: such as the Ascendant and the house of substance <note>The 2nd house.</note>, until it reaches the 12th. And when he is retrograde, it will be just as I told you concerning Mars. And this will be more severe from a conjunction. And if he is joined to the Lord of the Year, it will be even more severe for the king in the lands and the climate where he is. After this, obser-

-ve the attainment and victory from the stronger of the planets; for that planet signifies the multitude of soldiers through its strength, just as you observe the testimony of the planets and their strength in their places. 

After this, observe the speed of victory and its slowness from **Jupiter** and **Saturn**, and from the testimonies of their conjunctions and their "profection" <note>A symbolic advancement of a chart by one sign per year/period.</note> at the root, according to their course and in the "greater years" of the circle in which the **Great Conjunction** <note>original: "coniunctio medja"; the meeting of Saturn and Jupiter, which happens every 20 years and was believed to signal major historical shifts.</note> occurs. This conjunction shifts from one **triplicity** <note>A group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element (Fire, Earth, Air, Water).</note> to another triplicity; by their movement at the root, a change of **sects** <note>Religious groups or denominations.</note> and kingdoms is brought about. For what I have told you is signified in their conjunction in three ways, and I will make this clear to you in the following chapter. 

And when you have done this, proceed as you do in the revolution of the years of a birth according to the root of the nativity. For you will take the significations of sects and kingdoms from the conjunction of Saturn and Jupiter and their shift from triplicity to triplicity. Observe also the presence of the three planets that are above the Sun <note>The outer planets: Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn.</note> and their places in the fixed, movable, and common signs. Place them at the hour of a king’s destruction; and I will make this clear to you in the course of Saturn and Mars, and I will explain all these things to you. 

Know that when the malefics—namely **Saturn and Mars**—are in a sign of **human form** <note>Signs like Gemini, Virgo, Libra, or Aquarius, which are depicted as humans.</note>, and another malefic is joined to them, and he is direct or retrograde by conjunction, or in a 4th aspect or opposition, there will be **pestilences** among men. But if he is retrograde, it will be more cunning and swift. You must also observe whether the aspect or conjunction is from an "angle" <note>The four most powerful houses: 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th.</note>; for if it is so, it will be more cunning and powerful. Observe then in which angle it resides. If, however, it is Saturn (who is slower) in the 4th house or the Midheaven, and a retrograde planet is joined to him in the 7th, this evil will come from the **western region**, and the matter will be signified and strengthened. And if the slower planet is in the west and the retrograde planet joined to him is in the 4th, it will begin in the region I told you until it reaches the west.

After this, observe the manner of the beginning from the part of the faster planet that is joined to the heavier one. And know that the evil will reach the place of the slower, heavier one. And know that a retrograde planet "joined"—that is, the one who joins—when he is in a **common sign** <note>Signs like Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, or Pisces, which bridge the seasons.</note>, there will be death from war or killings; and in fixed and immovable signs, it will be according to what the stronger of the malefics signifies in his place. If **Mars** is stronger, it will be from war or from a "hot" sickness. But if **Saturn** is stronger, death will be from every infirmity that is of the nature of Saturn; and mix with it the strength of Mars. And if what we have said occurs outside of an angle, it will be slight; afterwards it shall be resolved, if God wills.

## Chapter 2: On the revolutions of the years of the world regarding severity.

After this, observe whether they are "received" in their places or not; for if they are received, their hindrance will be less. And if there is sickness in that same year, only a few will die. And if it signifies killing, there will be wounds but only a small amount of killing; and men will have mercy on one another. And know that the **Head of the Dragon** <note>The North Node of the Moon.</note> agrees with the fortunes, and the **Tail** <note>The South Node of the Moon.</note> assists the malefics. 

Therefore, observe the conjunction of the Head and Saturn; for it signifies according to the substance of the sign in which it is joined, just as it signifies in the eclipses of the luminaries. For when it is as I told you in **Aries** and its triplicity, it will be among beasts and wolves, according to the substance of the sign in which they are joined. And if it is in **Taurus** and its triplicity, it will be...

### Chapter on fear regarding the king.

**C**um—When in the revolution of the year the Significator of the year enters into **combustion**, the king of that same region shall die. And if he is at the summit of the rays, grief and sadness shall come upon him. But if a Fortune looks upon him, he shall escape. And if he is in the state I told you, and has already passed through combustion, distress and contention shall come upon him, but afterward he shall be released from it, and his state will improve—unless a malefic planet looks upon him, for then it signifies a prolongation of these things and their severity; and he shall be feared for according to the nature of the sign, whether it be sickness or death. 

Look for the hour of that signification from the time of the conjunction of the Significator and the malefic. Similarly, when a malefic looks upon the king's Significator by **opposition** or by a **square aspect** <note>original: "quarto aspectu"; a 90-degree angle, considered a tense or challenging relationship between planets.</note>, or by conjunction: fear shall be upon him when he is with the "Good" <note>Jupiter or Venus</note> that I mentioned in an **Angle** <note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses, which are the most powerful positions in a chart.</note>. And the time for this will be during the combustion of the Significator, and at the arrival of that same malefic at the place of the Significator, or at the Midheaven, or at the Ascendant—unless a Fortune helps him by an aspect, and that same malefic is a helper by nature. 

And whoever the malefic is, he himself shall be the significator of the king, because distress enters upon men from the king's side; and it is more powerful if he is in an Angle, for then it signifies that he will not grow weary from their distress. And if he is in the Midheaven with this which I told you, the distress will come from certain foreigners; and this will be in the place of the malefic if he is in the East, and similarly if he is in the West. And if he is in the Midheaven, it will be generally for all other men, and especially in the direction of **Benetnash** <note>original: "benetbnas .i. vise maiozis"; referring to the star Alkaid in the constellation Ursa Major, used here to signify the North.</note>, by which the North is signified. And if he is in the part of the Angle of the Earth <note>The 4th house.</note>, it will be in the East and among the "Acceden" <note>original: "acceden .i. nigroꝛum"; likely referring to the "Athiopes" or Black peoples of the South/East in medieval geography.</note>. 

And it is similar for the Fortunes, unless they are retrograde and in a bad place—that is, in their "descensions" or in the oppositions of their houses—because these are places of enmity for them, where they are weakened. Scrutatize, therefore, the parts in which they are, and look at the planet by which the king and his state are signified; and pronounce upon the state of the planets and their perfection day by day, regarding distress and scarcity or abundance, whether of good or evil. After this, look at the **reception of light** and its pulsing, for this signifies what will happen to the commoners <note>original: "rusticis"; literally "peasants" or "country-folk."</note>.

<column-break/>

### ¶ Question of war: and which of the two shall win.

And if you are asked concerning a war, whether it shall be, and which of them shall obtain the victory: look to the one you wish to observe, what his state is in that same year, and how the Significator of the king and the Lord of the Year look upon him. If he is in a strong place, and the Significator of the king does not look upon him, but the Lord of the Year looks upon him regarding every part of the interrogation, the king shall be heavy <note>troubled or burdened</note>, and the king will not help him; but there will be helpers from among the king's household. 

But if the Significator of the king looks upon him, pronounce the king’s help toward him, according to the aspect and its strength or weakness. For if they are enemies by nature, you will see him being wronged by him. And if he is of a peacemaking nature, judge according to what you see. I have indicated this to you so that you may marvel, and know how to observe these chapters, for nothing of this method in its description shall be hidden from you. And know the reasoning of his faults, just as I told you in the chapter on the revolution: do not neglect to look into every destruction or adaptation, and see with this the help of the planets toward him, according to the substance of the **Lords** <note>original: "deoꝛum"; likely a scribal error or archaism for the planetary "gods" or "lords."</note> through their length and brevity.

### ¶ Question of the hindrance of mortality & in what part they die.

And know that a planet which is "under the rays" <note>combust by the Sun</note> will hinder the citizens of that same **climate** <note>A geographical zone or latitude.</note>, and destroy their state, and cause them to be subjugated—this is more powerful if it is in an Angle during the revolution, or if a malefic looks upon it. For if it is under the rays as I told you, and is at the end of the sign in which it resides, and a malefic looks upon it from before it, and another malefic from behind it, that climate shall suffer according to the magnitude of the malefic aspect. 

For if there is a conjunction in one sign, the whole of them shall perish. And if it is in opposition, half of them. But if it is from a square aspect, a fourth part of them. If, however, Saturn precedes and Mars is after him, they shall be taken captive, and only a few of them shall be killed. But if Mars precedes and Saturn is after him, the whole of them shall be killed. 

After this, look to the malefic who looks upon the Significator of the king: if he looks upon him from the sign in which the king has "testimony" <note>Astrological strength or dignity.</note>, the enemy will be from his own land. And if he looks from the house of the king's Significator, he will be from his own household. And if he looks from his Exaltation, he will be from among the nobles who are his peers and of the same rank; while the Triplicity and Term signify the citizens of his dominion. 

And know that the **trine** and **sextile** aspects signify kindred, and **opposition** signifies enemies. The "first" square aspect <note>The 4th house aspect</note> signifies the house of the fathers; while the "second" square <note>The 10th house aspect</note> signifies the well-born and noble who are like him, of those who are fit for the kingdom. In a conjunction, look to the sign we mentioned: for if he has testimony in it, the enemy will be from among his relatives, of those who were raised with him. And if he has no testimony there, they will be of the same lineage. Observe these chapters most carefully. 

After this, look at the places of the **Luminaries** <note>The Sun and Moon</note> and their strength, and their separation, and to which planets they are joined; for a sextile or trine conjunction is weak, but an opposition or conjunction is strong. Observe this chapter most carefully, because it signifies the measure of their strength. 

I will now indicate to you the universal works of the **7 planets** and their significations:
*   The **Sun** signifies the king.
*   The **Moon** signifies the whole of the common people.
*   **Jupiter** signifies the nobles.
*   **Mars** signifies the warriors.
*   **Saturn** signifies the religious men of the faith.
*   **Venus** signifies women.
*   **Mercurius** signifies merchants and children.

Therefore, look when any of these are "punctated" <note>emphasized or specifically marked in the year's chart</note>, whether they have a part in that same year: for if they have a part, the distress and detriment I mentioned will enter upon them. Their "part" is to be in the Ascendant, or in the Midheaven, by their degree and sign—except for Venus and the Moon: for when these are in their own houses in the West, or in the Angle of the Earth <note>the 4th house</note>, they signify a strong hindrance; for these two belong to the father, and Mars similarly.

### Chapter on the division of the world and the climates according to the substances of the planets and signs.

Know <image-desc>Decorative initial E with internal floral motifs and a paragraph mark inside the frame.</image-desc> $\P$ that the world is divided into three divisions according to the substances of the three planets which are above the Sun, namely according to their substances and their temperaments <note>original: "complexiones"; refers to the balance of qualities like hot, cold, moist, and dry.</note>. Therefore, the upper part of the world belongs to Saturn: and the middle part of the world belongs to Jupiter: and this is the temperate part, similar to the substance of Jupiter: while the lower part belongs to Mars: which is the part of heat and is according to the substance of Mars: and the Moon shares with Saturn in his part: because her sign [the sign of Cancer] is opposite his sign [Capricorn]: therefore, from the quality of the year for the citizens of this part, there is a lack of wisdom and certainty: and a cutting off of piety: and forgetfulness. Their pains also are red and white: and similarly there is whiteness and forgetfulness among them. For their temperament is formed from the darkness of the earth and the air. $\P$ And Mercury shares with Jupiter: because his house is opposite the house of the other. Also, the quality of the mind of the citizens of this part is wisdom: and certainty and religion and truth and the sting of piety: and sharpness of wit: and their colors are of diverse compositions mixed, namely from whiteness and blackness and redness: because $\P$ their houses are mixed from the cold of the earth and the heat of the air: the division of these people $\P$ is more worthy and more precious than the other divisions: and their land is better than other lands, the land of prophets and wise men. And Venus shares with Mars: because her house is opposite his house, just as we said before: also, from the quality of the mind of the citizens of that same part, there is baseness: and the desire for Venus <note>referring to lust or carnal desire</note>: for drinking and for games: according to the locations of the same planets: and their colors are "combust" <note>original: "combusti"; meaning burnt or scorched</note> from the heat of the earth and the air: and the Sun shares with Jupiter and Mercury in their parts. $\P$ The climates also are divided according to these modes in worldly quality and the colors of bodies according to the order of the circle in its latitude: after this, they are divided among the 12 signs, which are the gates or parts of the circle, and in these there are 360 paths divided by the degrees of the Sun: and they become 21 thousand and 600 half-gates or parts: smaller ones, however, are not necessary except in the revolution of the world: and specifically in the revolution of the year in the chapters of the Sun: he means to be understood in the "equation of the Sun" <note>the calculation used to find the Sun's true position</note>: so that the degree of the Ascendant and the quarters may not be hidden from you. $\P$ Likewise, the East and its wind is hot and dry. The West and its wind is cold and moist. The South and its wind is hot and moist. The North and its wind is cold and dry. And similarly, Aries and its triplicity <note>the group of three signs: Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius</note> is hot and dry. Taurus and its triplicity is cold and dry. Gemini and its triplicity is hot and moist. Cancer and its triplicity is cold and moist. They have also related that in the 7 climates which make up the world, there are cities and fortresses: and villages according to the number of the 12 signs of heaven, just as the 12 signs which are great cities from which there are in each climate: 2 of Saturn, 2 of Jupiter, 2 of Mars, 1 of the Sun, 2 of Venus, 2 of Mercury, and 1 of the Moon. $\P$ And I will reveal to you how many cities: and fortresses: and villages they have related to be in the 7 climates. For in the first climate they said there were 3100. And in the 2nd climate 1713. In the 3rd climate 1077. In the fourth 2944. In the fifth 3006. In the sixth 3408. In the seventh 3300.

# Concerning the Revolutions of the Years

[The significator] is joined to it <note>Mars</note>: killing will be feared for him. And if he is joined to Saturn: he will fear distress and poison. And if the Lord of the Ascendant and of the year is **combust** <note>rendered invisible and astrologically weakened by being too close to the Sun</note> in the Midheaven: what I have said will occur in the same ways I described; it will happen in his own region where he is, and not outside that land. And if the combustion occurs in the "angle of the earth" <note>the 4th house, representing the foundations of the land</note> or in the opposite of the Ascendant (that is, in the 7th house): what I have said will come from someone who comes from outside the land. The opposition of the malifics <note>harmful planets like Saturn and Mars</note> and their quartile aspect <note>a 90-degree angle</note> is more severe than their conjunction in this chapter. And when the Sun is the **significator of the king** and looks upon Jupiter from an opposition: the king will become an enemy to his own household, and he will suspect them and burden them. Similarly, when it is opposite the Lord of the Ascendant: he will be an enemy to the **commoners** <note>original: "rusticis"; refers to the rural laboring class</note>, and he will suspect them and hinder them.

Next, know the "reception" of the planets by one another and the projection of their rays. Know the friendship and enmity of the Ascendant and its Lord. Know that when both of the malifics—namely, Saturn and Mars—are in an angle during the revolution of the year, and one of them is "direct" <note>moving forward</note> in an Earth sign, it signifies the destruction of trees and the death of animals. And if Mars aspects the significator of the king and is combust by the light of Saturn: it signifies strife and the shedding of blood. If it is in a Fire sign: it signifies injuries and enmities. If it is not in an angle but aspects the Ascendant and is direct: it signifies sickness from the winds and the blood; this is more severe in every land where its light falls, or in its opposite, or in a quartile aspect. And if it is **retrograde** <note>appearing to move backward in the sky</note>: it signifies pestilence. If it is in a sign that does not aspect the Ascendant and is direct: it will signify infirmity and the ruin of seeds. If it is retrograde: it will signify death, bloodshed, and infirmity. 

And if Mars is the Lord of the Year and is in Fire signs and direct in an angle: it signifies a hot, dry illness, and powerful men will contend with each other. If it is retrograde: this will be more severe, and destruction and thieves will multiply. If it is in Fire signs outside an angle and does not aspect the Ascendant: men will injure one another, and this will be more severe in the sign where its quartile aspect or opposition falls; there will be the hindrance I told you of according to the substance of that sign and the nature of that planet. 

And if Saturn is the Lord of the Year and is in the East and its **triplicity** <note>a group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element</note>, and is direct in an angle: it will signify much rain and strife among the wealthy, and even more so if it receives the "disposition" of Mars and its strength, for then it signifies that the commoners will contend with the king. If it is retrograde: the life of oxen will be burdened. If it is far from an angle but aspects the Ascendant: distress will enter among the nobles if it is direct. If it is retrograde: it will destroy houses and property. If it receives its disposition from Mars and the Moon: it signifies severe cold and the death of animals, along with the wars and strife I mentioned. If it is "falling" <note>in a cadent house, a weak position</note> and does not aspect the Ascendant, and is direct: the cold of winter will be worsened. If it is retrograde: there will be contention and rebellion among the commoners. 

And if Saturn is Lord of the Year and is in Earth signs direct in an angle: it signifies contention, war, and the death of animals in the land specifically belonging to that sign. If it is retrograde: it will destroy the harvests and seeds, and young people will die—even more so if it is in the Midheaven. If it is far from an angle but aspects the Ascendant: it will destroy seeds, young people will die, and harvests will be few. If it does not aspect the Ascendant: the evil will be slight. And when Saturn is Lord of the Year and is in Gemini and its triplicity <note>the Air signs</note>, and is in the angle of the Ascendant of the year: northern winds will be generated, and they will be strong and harmful; the commoners will suffer according to the nature of Saturn, and there will be war among men,

<column-break/>

strife, and the shedding of blood. If it is retrograde: it signifies contention among the wealthy and noble. If it is far from an angle and is direct: the cold of winter and the winds will be heavy. If it is retrograde and remote: it signifies winds and infirmity. If it is "falling" and does not aspect the Ascendant, and is direct: southern winds and infirmities will multiply; this will generally happen among common people. 

And if it is in the "angle of the earth" <note>the 4th house</note> and is the Lord of the Year in this triplicity: it signifies an earthquake. If it is not the Lord but receives the disposition of the Lord of the Ascendant and is itself in this place: men will die in the earthquake. If it receives the disposition of the Lord of the Midheaven: it signifies strife and war for the acquisition of the kingdom. And if Saturn is the Lord of the Year and is in Water signs and in an angle: the cold will be worsened and locusts will multiply. If it is retrograde: there will be a very great war and violent death. If it is far from an angle: rains and waters will multiply. If it is falling and not aspecting the Ascendant: it signifies the infirmity of the citizens of the sign in which it resides. If it is retrograde: the cold will be worsened and locusts will multiply. And if it is joined to a **planet of fortune** <note>a benefic planet like Jupiter or Venus</note>: it diminishes the severity of the ill.

---

->Here ends Messahallach on the revolution of the years of the world.<-
